error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[SCTP]   Received SCTP SHUTDOWN EVENT"

Context:
This SCTP shutdown event indicates that the SCTP association between the CU and DU has been terminated, which is critical as it disrupts the control plane communication necessary for UE context and session management. Following this event, the log shows removal of the SCTP endpoint and releasing of the DU ID on assoc_id 337, confirming loss of connectivity that would prevent normal system operation.
